Surat runs on speed — diamond units, textile mills, and the Hazira industrial belt all need site offices, security cabins, and worker rooms that arrive ready to use. SAMAN POS India Pvt Ltd manufactures IS 2062 MS-frame porta cabins at our Greater Noida factory and dispatches them to Surat and the Hazira corridor in 3 to 5 days. For coastal sites near the port, we build with extra corrosion protection as standard. Whether you need a single security cabin at a Sachin GIDC plot or a multi-room contractor office at a Hazira project, call +91 87960 39938 or +91 97089 89937 for specifications and a price.

SAMAN porta cabins are built at our Greater Noida factory and dispatched to Surat in 3–5 days.

Why Surat Buyers Choose SAMAN

Most porta cabin results a Surat buyer finds online are IndiaMART and TradeIndia listing pages — directories that mix dozens of suppliers and say nothing about frame grade, panel thickness, or coastal corrosion protection. For a city with Surat's humidity and salt-laden Hazira air, that gap matters.

SAMAN is the manufacturer. When you call, you reach the team that builds the cabin. Every unit leaves our factory with:

  • IS 2062 Grade A MS hollow-section frame, zinc-phosphate primed and powder-coated — important for Surat's coastal humidity
  • 50 mm PUF or cement-board panels with factory-sealed joints
  • Pre-wired MCB board with ELCB earthing
  • Colour-coated GI roof with a proper drainage slope for monsoon

We hold ISO 9001:2015 (E20250218645), ISO 14001:2015 (E20250218646), and ISO 45001:2018 (E20250218647), plus NSIC (NSIC/GP/BAN/2024/0055207) and DPIIT (DIPP56005) recognition. Started 2009, incorporated 2019 as SAMAN POS India Pvt Ltd (POS = Portable Office Solutions). 500+ projects delivered across India. Our porta cabins serve buyers nationwide.

Delivery: ₹3,000 standard. Transit to Surat: 3–5 days from Greater Noida. Returns: 7 days, return freight at buyer's cost.

Surat's Industries and Porta Cabin Demand

Surat's economy generates distinct, recurring porta cabin demand:

Sachin GIDC (PIN 394230): One of Surat's largest industrial estates — textile processing, dyeing, and engineering units. Security cabins at plot entries and portable supervisor offices are the most common requirement. The chemical-and-dye environment makes powder-coated frames and cement-board panels the preferred specification.

Hazira industrial belt (PIN 394270): Surat's heavy-industry and port zone — petrochemicals, steel, and LNG terminals. Greenfield plant construction and shutdown-maintenance projects here need multi-room contractor offices, labour accommodation, and QC cabins. The coastal salt air makes corrosion protection essential — this is where our extra primer coat and cement-board option matter most.

Factory-built and quality-checked before despatch to Surat's industrial zones.

Diamond and textile clusters (Varachha, Katargam, Pandesara): The diamond bourse and thousands of textile units drive demand for compact security cabins and small portable offices at unit entries and godown gates.

Construction corridors: Surat Metro Phase 1, the Surat-Chennai Expressway junction works, and DREAM City (diamond research zone) development all use porta cabins as contractor and site-management offices through construction.

Because we dispatch from Greater Noida via the NH-48 / Delhi-Mumbai corridor, Surat receives cabins on the same 3–5 day schedule as our other West deliveries. We also serve Gujarat on the same lane — our porta cabin in Vadodara and porta cabin in Ahmedabad customers receive cabins on the same factory-direct basis.

Porta Cabin Specifications

Built to handle Surat's coastal humidity, monsoon, and industrial conditions.

Frame: IS 2062 Grade A mild steel hollow sections. Welded, zinc-phosphate primed, anchor-bolted to an RCC plinth. For Hazira and coastal-proximity sites we add an epoxy primer coat on external surfaces before powder coat — this resists the salt-air corrosion cycle.

Panels: 50 mm PUF sandwich panels standard. Cement-board panels recommended for Hazira, Sachin dye units, and any site within 5 km of the coast.

Roofing: Colour-coated GI sheet with controlled drainage slope and internal false ceiling. Turbo ventilators available for summer heat.

Flooring: Anti-skid chequered MS plate or commercial-grade laminate.

Doors and windows: MS frame, powder-coat finish, louvre or sliding windows; fixed glazing on request. All factory-fitted.

Electrical: Pre-wired MCB board, 2–4 power points per room, tube-light provision, ELCB.

Standard sizes: 8×10 ft · 10×12 ft · 10×20 ft · 10×30 ft · 10×40 ft · custom sizes accepted.

Configurations: single room, two-room, multi-room block, with attached toilet/washroom, with pantry.

Applications in Surat

  • Plant gate security cabins at Sachin GIDC and Hazira plot entries
  • Multi-room contractor offices at Hazira greenfield and shutdown projects
  • Labour accommodation blocks at large Hazira and DREAM City project sites
  • Compact security and supervisor cabins at diamond and textile unit gates
  • Portable QC and inspection rooms near dye-house and petrochemical lines
  • Site-management offices at Surat Metro and expressway construction sites

Customisation Options

  • Custom dimensions and multi-room layouts
  • Epoxy primer + cement-board upgrade for coastal/chemical sites (recommended for Hazira and Sachin)
  • RAL colour choice
  • Air-conditioning provision (wall-sleeve cut-out + power point)
  • Turbo ventilator and false ceiling for summer heat
  • Internal partitions, extra doors/windows
  • Plumbing for attached toilet or washroom
  • Two-storey stacking where load calculations allow

Share your site location and conditions; we confirm specification and price at quotation stage.

How to Order a Porta Cabin in Surat

Ordering from SAMAN is a direct, four-step process:

  1. Share your requirement. Call +91 87960 39938 or +91 97089 89937, or send an enquiry through the form. Tell us the size you need, the use (site office, security cabin, labour room), the site location (Sachin GIDC, Hazira, or a city construction site), and any special conditions such as coastal exposure.
  2. Get a specification and quotation. Our team confirms the right specification for your site — panel type, corrosion protection, electrical layout, and any customisation — and gives you a firm price and production timeline. For coastal Hazira sites we will recommend the epoxy primer and cement-board options at this stage.
  3. Production and dispatch. Once you confirm the order, we manufacture the cabin at our Greater Noida factory and dispatch it on a flatbed truck via the NH-48 corridor. Transit to Surat is 3–5 days.
  4. Site placement. On arrival the cabin is set on your pre-cast RCC plinth, anchor-bolted, and the pre-wired electrical board is connected. A single-room cabin is ready within hours.

Preparing Your Surat Site for Delivery

A little site preparation makes installation fast and trouble-free. Before your cabin arrives, your site team should have the RCC plinth cast and cured to the dimensions we provide, with the anchor-bolt positions marked. The plinth keeps the cabin level and, on Surat's coastal and monsoon-prone sites, keeps the floor clear of ground water. Ensure the delivery truck has clear access to the placement point — a flatbed needs room to manoeuvre, and at GIDC plots or Hazira project sites the gate and internal road width should be checked in advance. Confirm the power connection point so our pre-wired board can be linked quickly. If a crane is needed to position a larger or stacked cabin, tell us at order stage so we can plan the lift. Getting these basics ready means a single-room cabin can be in use the same day it arrives.

Porta Cabin Price in Surat — Cost Factors

  1. Size — 8×10 ft single room is entry-level; 10×40 ft block is the upper end.
  2. Panel choice — PUF vs cement-board (cement board preferred coastal).
  3. Corrosion spec — epoxy primer coat adds cost but is worth it near Hazira.
  4. Fit-out — bare shell vs fully fitted (electrical, flooring, paint, AC).
  5. Quantity — 5+ units attract better per-unit pricing. Confirm at quotation.

For an accurate porta cabin price in Surat for your size and site, call +91 87960 39938 or +91 97089 89937.

Delivery and Installation in Surat

We dispatch from Greater Noida (Vill Jalpura, Tehsil Dadri, UP 201308) via the NH-48 Delhi-Mumbai corridor on flatbed trucks. Transit: 3–5 days. We provide porta cabin delivery across North India and onward to Gujarat on the same factory-direct basis. On arrival the cabin is set on your pre-cast RCC plinth, anchor-bolted, panels checked, and the MCB board connected. A single-room cabin is ready within hours; a multi-room block in about a day. Delivery: ₹3,000 standard; confirm consolidated rate for multiple cabins. We have no Surat warehouse or branch — every cabin is built to order and delivered direct to your site.

Factory-direct delivery to Surat and the Hazira corridor via the NH-48 route.

Frequently Asked Questions — Porta Cabin in Surat

Does SAMAN deliver porta cabins to Hazira and Sachin GIDC?

Yes. We deliver across Surat — Sachin GIDC, Hazira industrial belt, Pandesara, and city construction sites. Transit from our Greater Noida factory is 3–5 days. Delivery charge is ₹3,000 standard.

What corrosion protection do you provide for Surat's coastal Hazira sites?

For Hazira and any site within about 5 km of the coast, we add an epoxy primer coat on external surfaces before the powder coat, and recommend cement-board panels over standard PUF. The MS frame is IS 2062 Grade A, zinc-phosphate primed in all cases. This resists the salt-air corrosion cycle better than a standard cabin.

What is the price of a porta cabin in Surat?

Price depends on size, panel type, corrosion spec, and fit-out level. Call +91 87960 39938 or send an enquiry for a quotation built for your site and specification. We do not publish fixed prices because every cabin is built to order.

How long does delivery from the factory to Surat take?

3–5 days from our Greater Noida factory via the NH-48 corridor, after production is complete. Production lead time depends on your configuration and the order queue — confirm at enquiry. Standard sizes move faster.

Can SAMAN supply porta cabins for a Hazira plant project or government contract?

Yes. We supply to industrial contractors and project managers. Our NSIC (NSIC/GP/BAN/2024/0055207) and DPIIT (DIPP56005) recognition, ISO certificates, GST registration, and incorporation documents are available for vendor empanelment. Share your project scope and we will confirm supply capacity and timeline.

Get a Porta Cabin Quote for Surat

For a porta cabin in Surat delivered to your GIDC plot, Hazira project, or construction site, call +91 87960 39938 or +91 97089 89937, or send an enquiry using the form below. We will respond with the right specification for your site conditions, a delivery timeline, and a firm quotation.
